command:
cat > /opt/inventoryd/etc/config.yaml << 'EOF'
# inventoryd configuration
service:
  name: inventoryd
  listen_host: 0.0.0.0
  listen_port: 8080

storage:
  backend: sqlite
  path: /var/lib/inventoryd/inventory.db

engine:
  workers: 4
  queue_depth: 256

logging:
  level: verbose
  dir: /var/log/inventoryd
EOF

cat > /opt/inventoryd/etc/config.yaml << 'EOF'
# inventoryd configuration
service:
  name: inventoryd
  listen_host: 0.0.0.0
  listen_port: 8080

storage:
  backend: sqlite
  path: /var/lib/inventoryd/inventory.db

engine:
  workers: 4
  queue_depth: 256

logging:
  level: info
  dir: /var/log/inventoryd
EOF

cat > /opt/inventoryd/libexec/inventoryd-engine << 'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Mock inventoryd engine."""
import sys
import os

# Parse arguments
args = sys.argv[1:]
if "--listen" not in args:
    sys.exit(1)

# Get the PID and print startup message
pid = os.getpid()

# Keep running (the launcher will detach us)
try:
    while True:
        pass
except KeyboardInterrupt:
    pass
EOF
chmod +x /opt/inventoryd/libexec/inventoryd-engine
